supplementalResident.scope: Retained main-created geometry, separate from architectural snapshots and their batching; lamps disabled by default

kind: CPU geometry and resource ownership inventory; not WebGL/GPU/FPS evidence
limitations: Textures have manifest dimensions but are not decoded or uploaded.

Architectural snapshots exclude helicopter and optional sky-lamp geometry, which are inventoried separately in supplementalResident. Their additional batch copies are not included. Future main-created fixture classes require explicit capture integration. Environment lights, IBL and postprocessing GPU targets are excluded. Architectural render batch geometry and matrix texture capacity are reported separately; not GPU allocation.
Visible counts respect ancestor visibility, not camera frustum, occlusion, material visibility, or draw calls.
Geometry bytes are unique backing ArrayBuffer sizes, not complete JS or GPU memory.
All resident LOD levels and cached prebuilt zones are included.
Optional model parsing exercises actual loader install/unload with the pinned bundled CPU Draco decoder, but not browser-worker/network fetch or image decode.
CPU elapsed times are diagnostic only, not device performance claims.
